title: websave
summary: Download URL content into a file.

gpu_support.notes: Host-side compatibility builtin; GPU-resident inputs are gathered before execution.

description: Download URL content into a file.
behaviors: Downloads HTTP or HTTPS URL content through the shared RunMat HTTP transport and writes it through the active filesystem provider.
Supports a leading weboptions-style struct for Timeout, UserAgent, and HeaderFields.
Treats trailing name-value pairs as URL query parameters, with Timeout and UserAgent handled as request options.
Rejects unpaired or unsupported option shapes instead of silently ignoring them.
